results.description:
I'm Knox Sterling. Self-made billionaire. Playboy.
My whole life, I've chased women, thrills, and anything that keeps things uncomplicated.
Commitment? Not my style.
Except for Amy. My best friend is the only woman who's ever been completely off-limits. She's the one person who's kept me grounded since the days when my bank account barely covered rent.

The one woman I've secretly wanted for years… but never touched.
But after a minor car crash reminds me how quickly life can change, waiting suddenly feels like the worst mistake.
So when Amy asks me to chaperone a school field trip and inspire her students with stories from my career, I say yes without hesitation. Any excuse to spend more time with her.
But the trip doesn't go as planned. A freak accident leaves us stranded in a small town overnight.
Just the two of us.
One hotel room.
Years of tension finally snapping.
One reckless kiss turns into an unforgettable night.
Falling for my best friend might be the most dangerous move I've ever made…
But once I have her in my bed, there's no way I'm letting her walk away.

Tropes in Forbidden Kisses:
Friends to lovers
Billionaire hero
Forced proximity
One hotel room
